name: Flutter Foundation CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [dev, main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  foundation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          flutter-version: '3.47.5'
          cache: true
      - name: Reject unresolved merge markers
        run: dart run tool/check_merge_markers.dart
      - run: flutter pub get
      - run: dart run build_runner build
      - run: flutter analyze
      - name: Foundation, Platform API and contract tests
        run: flutter test
      - run: flutter build web --release --no-wasm-dry-run --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=https://api.example.invalid

  container:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: docker compose config --quiet
      - run: docker compose build

  production-container:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build production image
        run: >-
          docker build -f Dockerfile.vercel
          --build-arg API_BASE_URL=https://api.example.invalid
          -t saas-platform-client:prod .
      - name: Smoke test production container
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker run -d --name production-smoke -e PORT=8080 -p 8080:8080 saas-platform-client:prod
          ready=false
          for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
            if [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8080/ || true)" = 200 ]; then
              ready=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done
          [ "$ready" = true ]
          curl --fail -sS -D /tmp/frontend-headers http://localhost:8080/ -o /tmp/frontend-index
          curl --fail -sS http://localhost:8080/dashboard -o /tmp/frontend-spa
          cmp /tmp/frontend-index /tmp/frontend-spa
          grep -qi 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' /tmp/frontend-headers
          grep -qi 'Cache-Control: no-cache' /tmp/frontend-headers
          docker exec production-smoke sh -c '! command -v flutter && ! command -v dart'
      - name: Clean up
        if: always()
        run: docker rm -f production-smoke || true
